title: 6 Best Dialpad Alternatives for Hotels (2026)
summary: Dialpad alternatives for hotels in 2026: property-line VoIP, call groups, VoiceAI, SMS, and where Conduit fits as a real hotel phone system.
body_markdown:
*Written by Punn Kam, ex-Google AI engineer and Y Combinator repeat founder. He is the co-founder of Conduit, an AI agent platform purpose-built for hospitality, supporting 300+ hospitality brands in over 120 countries. Last updated September 2, 2026.*


Hotels looking for Dialpad alternatives need guest messaging plus a real hotel phone system on the published number. Conduit ports that line, runs VoiceAI with Retell, ElevenLabs, or cloning, SMS, 24/7 or scheduled routing, static or dynamic escalation, warm and blind transfer, hold, voicemail, forwarding, web/mobile softphone, and Mobile Call Bridge.


## Why do hotels look for Dialpad alternatives?


Dialpad is a strong general business phone with Dialpad AI Agent across voice and digital channels. Hotels still have a different job: the published property number and the guest SMS thread must share one agent that can see the reservation. Per-user seats plus conversation-based AI credits also meter the bill on volume, which is a poor fit for seasonal occupancy.


Ask what the agent writes to when a caller wants a date change. If the answer is a task for a person, you still need a hotel phone system next to Dialpad.


## What should a hotel phone system do that Dialpad does not?


A hotel phone system is not a chat add-on. It has to own the line:


- Port the published hotel number.
- Answer with VoiceAI (Retell, ElevenLabs, or cloned voices).
- Send SMS in the same guest thread as the call.
- Route 24/7 or on a night schedule.
- Escalate statically (always the front office) or dynamically (by request).
- Warm-transfer with context, or blind-transfer when speed matters.
- Hold, voicemail, and forwarding so the desk can work the board like a PBX.
- Web and mobile softphone, plus Mobile Call Bridge so staff can take the property line on a cell without giving guests a personal number.
- Call recordings via recording_url when the provider returns one.


Dialpad covers the contact-center half of that list. It does not publish a hotel PMS integration, so reservation changes stay a human job unless you add another product. For queues, call groups, and a 20-second SLA at the desk, use the hotel-phone cut:[Dialpad call center alternatives for hotels](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/dialpad-call-center-alternatives-hotels) .


## Which Dialpad alternatives should hotels compare?

### RingCentral


The closest general-PBX substitute if you want a mature phone system and a fixed AI Receptionist SKU. Extra minutes are sold in bundles, so the meter is at least legible. It is still a business phone, not a hotel inbox.


### Quo, formerly OpenPhone


Flat per-user plans with the Sona agent. Search for Quo rather than OpenPhone. Fine for a small shared number. It is not a property line with PMS write-back.


### Aircall


Comparable contact-center depth with a three-licence minimum on published plans. The split between AI Voice Agents that answer and AI Assist that coaches humans is clearer than most. Hotel queues live on the[call-center page](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/dialpad-call-center-alternatives-hotels) .


### Goodcall and Smith.ai


Goodcall is per-agent with overage per customer, aimed at local service and BPO. Smith.ai meters answering in call bundles with steep overage. Neither is a hotel phone system.


### Conduit


Conduit is a real hotel phone system and guest agent in the same class as Dialpad for the property line, not the wrong tool. VoiceAI answers guest calls. You can port numbers, send SMS, run 24/7 or scheduled routing, set static or dynamic escalation, warm- or blind-transfer, hold, take voicemail, forward, run a web or mobile softphone, and use Mobile Call Bridge. Recordings are available via recording_url when the voice provider returns one. Voices are Retell, ElevenLabs, or cloning. Voice and text sit on one agent that writes back to connected PMS systems. Pricing is per unit from $18 a month with a monthly credit allowance included per unit. Watch-out: the product is built for hotels. If you need a general sales or support contact center with no reservation record, Dialpad remains the broader business-phone choice. That is a vertical fit, not a missing PBX.


## Who should stay on Dialpad?


Anyone running a general business contact operation where guests are a minority of callers. Dialpad AI Agent is a serious product, and conversation-based pricing can be fairer than idle seats.


Leave if the published number is the front desk and SMS is part of the same guest journey. Then you need a hotel phone system, not a second inbox. For hotel guest messaging next to the phone, see[best hotel guest messaging 2026](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/best-hotel-guest-messaging-2026) and[best AI messaging tools for hotels](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/best-ai-messaging-tools-for-hotels) .


## FAQ


### Why do hotels look for Dialpad alternatives?


Because Dialpad meters AI on conversations and does not publish a hotel PMS path. Hotels need the published number and guest SMS on one agent that can see the booking.


### What should a hotel phone system do that Dialpad does not?


Port the line, VoiceAI, SMS, 24/7 or scheduled routing, static or dynamic escalation, warm and blind transfer, hold, voicemail, forwarding, web/mobile softphone, Mobile Call Bridge, and recordings via recording_url when available.


### Which Dialpad alternatives should hotels compare?


RingCentral, Quo, Aircall, Goodcall, and Smith.ai for general phones. Conduit when you need a hotel phone system plus guest messaging. Compare PMS write-back, not just voice quality.


### Can Conduit replace Dialpad as the hotel phone and guest inbox?


Yes for the property line: VoiceAI, porting, SMS, routing, transfers, hold, voicemail, forwarding, softphone, Mobile Call Bridge. Watch-out: hospitality only, and you still plan the number port.


### Who should stay on Dialpad?


Corporate contact centers that already live in Dialpad Support or Sell, where hotel guests are overflow. Front-desk numbers belong on a hotel phone agent.


### Does Dialpad work with hotel property management systems?


No property management integration is published. Its ecosystem is general business tooling, so reservation changes are outside what the agent can complete on its own.
